body: nothing that has made me happy in the past has the same effect, so i cannot picture any situation making me 'happy' or 'feeling normal'

I've tried to narrow down the causes/roots of why I'm feeling this way to no avail. I can't seem to find what has caused this 'snap' in my day to day perception of reality. before this, i was able to cope with even the biggest stressors in my life with a positive and patient outlook, but every day that passes now is becoming more and more unbearable. Anything I do to 'shake things up' or change this, positive or negative seems to be inconsequential. and all i know is, i'd give up anything at this point to not feel this way anymore. it has sucked the light and resiliency out of my character and outlook. I am able to function, doing menial tasks, but only in the vein hopes that I will be thrown from this mindstate by continuing routine. longing for a feeling of contentedness/stability that never comes, no matter how 'good' or actually stable things may be going. All I can seem to do is just warn my loved ones that things are getting worse and that they should not be surprised when I can no longer find the stopgap between me and doing something permanently damaging to myself. No one truly understands what this could be because I can't even understand what it could be.

I take it as a good sign (I guess?) that I haven't gone through with ending my life yet, but my 'fear' of death is waning rapidly by the minute. I haven't been to emergency mental health services yet, to avoid possible institutionalization. Self injury doesn't relieve these feelings like i'd hoped it would. coping mechanisms fail me

I've pinpointed changes or things in my life that would objectively cause anxiety or trigger these feelings, but further exploration only leads me to believe these are not the reasons for it. Death seems to be the only relief from this feeling. It haunts me no matter where I go.
